_doc: Shadower line (spec #425, ticket SH2 #427). The second thief line after Night Lord, and the first dagger job: its job entry, its meso charge meter, its AP row, its bot card scores and its status-bonus catalogue entry. Skill definitions are in skills/shadower.json (SH6-SH12 append to it). An undefined skill key is never offered or learned. 422 is not playable yet (`playable` false; SH14 #439 flips it) and JobTree.default_job() stays 212 (survivor/jobs.json default_job). Ruling D15: the line is not in DataRepo.CLASS_LINES during the spec; DataRepo.lines() discovers it by its files and it is appended to CLASS_LINES at its redesign merge.

422._starting_skill: tier C: spec #425: Double Stab (4001334, book 400) is the starting active (slot 1) and the first skill a round learns; SH6 #431 moves it from skills/thief.json into skills/shadower.json.
422._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #425 D1: Assaulter (4211002) is the mobility skill on the skill key (the existing rush key, one job owns one), outside both slot tracks and never a card; it follows balance.mobility_rank_levels like Rush. Defined by SH7 #432.
422._skill_pool: tier C: spec #425: the nine hand-picked Shadower actives from the 400/420/421/422 books (Assaulter is the mobility skill, Assassinate a form sub-skill, neither a pool entry). Inert until SH6-SH12 define them: an undefined key is never offered or learned.
422._weapon_families: tier C: spec #425: daggers only (WeaponInfo family dagger, 133xxxx); claws (147xxxx) belong to Night Lord. Armour drops by the Thief class bit and Thief shields drop with a dagger (existing tier C rule).
422._creation_weapon: tier A item fact: the Razor 1332005 (reqJob 0 so any class can wear it, reqLevel 5 which is not enforced #292, PAD 20, a dagger); the choice is tier C, spec #425.
422._meter: tier C: spec #425 SH-10: the meso charge, a counter filled by meso pickups and never a currency (D7). 1 pip per 600 mesos picked up (Night Lord: 1000), max 10, NO decay (the finisher spends the charge, so a decay would be a race against a clock the player cannot see), +2% damage per held pip on every pool cast (Hero's Combo is +5%). Tier A fact: the art is the meso coin's animation frame, already imported for pickups. Read by PlayerMeter's meso_picked rule (NL4 #403).
422._hub_kit: tier C: spec #425 SH13 #438: the --hub / flow-driver test kit of a Shadower. Fixture = shadower_t2.json (the tier-1 dagger kit: Iron Dagger 1332010, Lv25 PAD 40); scrolls = the five dagger ATT scrolls of scrolls/thief.json (10%, 60%, 100%, dark 70%, dark 30%; 5 stacks of 10 within the Use tab); spare equipment = the all-job hat 1002001, a second dagger (1332000, Lv12 Thief), the all-job gloves 1082002 and a Thief-bit top (1040031, Lv10), all wearable by job 422; fallback_item = the Lv40 dagger 1332011 (Thief) the flow driver wears at Lv1 when a round dropped no equipment.

422._ap: tier C: spec #425: the Thief (400) row copied verbatim (the Thief gear pattern, no new tuning); explicit so 422 no longer falls back through 421/420/400. The HP baseline (decision SH-14) is added by the QA ticket, not here.

bot._card_scores: tier C: spec #425: the numbers BotInput's pool default gives every curated skill (learn 100, rank 74), written out for the three skills BotInput._base_score would not score as attacks: Dark Sight (a Form) and Smokescreen (a placed safe zone, damage none) are not projectile / instant / box skills, and Meso Explosion is the meter-gated finisher. The other six pool skills score as attacks by default.

balance._status_bonuses: spec #425 SH-13 (M22): the rarity status-bonus catalogue entry of Venomous Stab (4220005); NL3 #402's code parses and validates it, SH2 only stores it. Keys are global, so the entry has its own name. Tier A: chance, time and level are Venomous Stab's prop, time and rank -> poison level map (verified equal level for level to Night Lord's venomous_star, 4120005). Tier C: repeat_chance (points added per repeat of the same grant, scaled by the x0.8 repeat factor). The WZ text 'usable up to 3 times against each monster' is not modelled (the poison refreshes without stacking).
